column3: Customer's credit score. Higher = lower credit risk.
Country of the customer: France, Spain, or Germany. Requires encoding (one-hot or ordinal).
Number of years the customer has been with the bank (0–10)
Account balance in currency units. Zero is valid.
Number of bank products held (e.g. savings, loans, credit cards).
Whether customer has a credit card. 1 = Yes, 0 = No.
Whether the customer is an active member. 1 = Active, 0 = Inactive.
Bank's estimate of the customer's annual salary.
Whether the customer left the bank. 1 = Churned, 0 = Stayed.
